title: Modules registry foundation
summary: Admins can turn modules and integrations on or off from Admin → Modules. Microsoft 365 app links are now their own integration, so they can be paused without taking the rest of Communications offline.

added: Admin → Modules: see which modules and integrations are on, turn them off or on with a reason, and edit typed settings.
Microsoft 365 as its own integration: app links, the dashboard tile and Admin → Microsoft 365 links can be paused together.
changed: A disabled module no longer shows in the menu or on the dashboard, and its pages return not found until it is turned back on.

internal_notes: Shipped #166 ModuleRegistry + module_states/module_settings, #167 enforce disable everywhere, #168 Admin Modules screen (admin.modules.manage + fresh-signin), #169 microsoft-365 Integration extract. Rollback: docs/modules/microsoft-365-rollback.md. Epic #161.
